questions.question: Why should the two adaptation branches be compared using a common held-out criterion rather than their own training losses?
options: Teacher targets always make training loss zero
Their supervision differs, so their training losses answer different questions
Using the evaluation split during every update guarantees fairness
questions.explanation: The common held-out task defines the comparison. Different training targets can yield different loss values even when prediction quality is similar; evaluating the final split during model selection would also leak information.
